description: The workspace's tracked queries — the questions RankControl checks weekly across the 7 AI engines for brand citations — with their status and, for each tracked query, how many of the AI engines that answered it cited it in their latest check; `noAnswer` names an engine with no answer (Google shows an AI Overview for some questions only). `branded` marks a question that names your brand: it's checked and listed, but doesn't count toward your score.

engines.description: Only these engines' answers: their ids, comma-separated (chatgpt, perplexity, claude, gemini, grok, google_ai_mode, google_ai_overview). Leave it out for all seven.

topic.description: One topic's questions only: its id or name from get_topics, or none for questions with no topic. Leave it out for the whole workspace.

name: list_tracked_queries
